cases.message: What note groups am I missing in my collection, and where should I explore next?
cases.rubric: The answer must be based on note-group coverage of owned perfumes. It must name concrete underrepresented or missing note groups, must not prescribe mandatory purchases, and must not present itself as a full style/performance audit.

cases.message: Which of my perfumes do I rate the highest?
cases.rubric: The answer must list the highest rated owned perfumes in descending rating order, must include the top rated one, and must not invent perfumes the user does not own.

cases.message: Do I own anything I have never actually worn?
cases.rubric: The answer must identify the never-worn perfumes from the user's collection and must not claim that all perfumes have been worn.

cases.message: Which perfumes have I worn the least?
cases.rubric: The answer must list the least worn owned perfumes and must not include perfumes that the user does not own.

cases.message: I want to try something new for spring. Recommend perfumes I do not already own.
cases.rubric: The answer must recommend perfumes the user does not already own. It must not recommend or link perfumes the user already owns (for example Velvet Iris, Cedar Storm or Amber Resin), and it must not link any perfume using the owned-perfume markdown link format.

cases.message: I am in the mood for something cozy and warm. What should I wear?
cases.rubric: The answer must suggest owned perfumes that fit a cozy, warm mood and must not suggest perfumes the user does not own.

cases.message: Are there any decants or samples for sale that I should look at?
cases.rubric: The answer must describe offers that come from the locally imported marketplace offers. It must not invent offers, sellers, prices or external marketplace websites, and it must not claim to have browsed the internet.

cases.message: Hi there! What kinds of things can you help me with?
cases.rubric: The answer must be a short friendly capability overview of a perfume collection assistant and must not run a collection search or invent a list of perfumes.

cases.message: Can I actually wear my Atelier Nord - Empty Vetiver right now? Check how much is left in that bottle.
cases.rubric: The answer must identify Atelier Nord - Empty Vetiver as having 0 millilitres left and say that specific bottle is not available to wear. It may suggest another owned perfume, including Atelier Nord - Cedar Storm, if tool evidence shows it has liquid remaining. Do not treat other available perfumes containing vetiver as a failure.

cases.message: Make me a buy list of my favorites that need replenishing. Use your default rebuy criteria, including finished bottles.
cases.rubric: Recommend Last Amber (9/100 ml, 9%, rating 4.3) and Empty Vetiver (0/100 ml, 0%, rating 3.5). Explain strictly below 10% remaining and rating above 3. Do not recommend exactly 10%, rating 3, unrated bottles, or unknown capacity. No marketplace lookup is needed.

cases.message: Which Rebuy Lab favorites rated above 3 should I restock with less than 20% left? Include empty bottles.
cases.rubric: Use the explicit 20% threshold instead of the default 10%. Return Last Amber and Ten Percent, explaining their remaining percentages.

cases.message: List all Rebuy Lab bottles below 10% remaining, regardless of rating, including unrated and empty bottles.
cases.rubric: Honor regardless of rating: include Last Amber, Average Rose and Unrated Amber. Do not apply the default favorite-rating cutoff. Exactly 10% and unknown capacity do not qualify.

cases.message: My Rebuy Lab Full Sample only has 1.9 ml left. Check the bottle size: does it meet your default rebuy criteria?
cases.rubric: Use tool evidence to explain Full Sample has 1.9 of 2 ml left, or 95%, and does not meet the below-10% rebuy rule. Do not infer low supply from absolute millilitres.

cases.message: Check Rebuy Lab Unknown Capacity. What percentage is left, and does it need restocking?
cases.rubric: Recognize its capacity is unknown/nonpositive and RemainingPercent is null. Report the known 1 ml if useful, but do not invent a percentage or assert that the percentage-based restock threshold is met.

cases.message: Which available favorites rated above 3 have I not worn in at least 90 days?
cases.rubric: List available Sandalwood Ritual, Vanilla Smoke and Rose Absolue based on rating above 3 and last-worn dates. Exclude empty Empty Vetiver and Winter Wood rated exactly 3.

cases.message: Which available Atelier Nord perfumes tagged vetiver have I rated above 4?
cases.rubric: Apply house, vetiver tag, rating above 4 and availability together. Cedar Storm is the match, with rating 4.5 and 41 ml left.

cases.message: Do I have any available Rebuy Lab perfumes rated above 4.9?
cases.rubric: Say no perfumes match the requested criteria, based on a tool lookup. Do not invent a match or silently relax the threshold.

cases.message: Can I actually wear my vetiver perfume right now?
cases.rubric: The request does not uniquely name a bottle. Cedar Storm contains vetiver and has 41 ml left, so suggesting it with supporting tool evidence is valid. It is also valid to clarify which bottle is intended. If Empty Vetiver is discussed, it has 0 ml and cannot be worn. Do not require all vetiver-containing perfumes to be unavailable.
